Option A — Wed Dec 23 — 10:00–10:30 PT / 1:00–1:30 ET
Option B — Thu Dec 24 — 14:00–14:30 PT / 17:00–17:30 ET
Option C — Mon Dec 28 — 08:30–09:00 PT / 11:30–12:00 ET

Attached: proposed 30m agenda (PDF) and a short security questionnaire (Excel) that Priya asked about.

If none of these work, tell me two preferred windows next week and I’ll re-propose.
